headline: Urban Company Shares Gain 2% on Air Conditioner Market Entry
summary: Urban Company shares rose 2% to 173 rupees on the BSE after launching smart air conditioners with a five-year unconditional warranty.
why: Corporate expansions into consumer durable manufacturing diversify revenue streams and impact competitive dynamics in domestic retail markets.

impacts.name: Urban Company
impacts.why: Product expansion announcements into the AC market boosted the company's share price by 2%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The company announced its entry into the air conditioner market with a new product line and a five-year unconditional warranty.
